## Purpose
The catalog package. It holds one tree of business concepts (industry › domain › subdomain › process › subprocess) and the tags that file agents, tools, connectors, workflows and libraries under it. The tree is used to scope inventories and to give the rules engine typed facts.

## Responsibilities
- The docstring maps the modules: vocab, models, store, seed_loader, match and tagging.
- Re-exports from `vocab`: `AGENT_TIERS`, `AgentTier`, `DataClass`, `Predicate`, `Scheme`, `SubjectType`, `tier_labels` and `tier_rules_block`.

## Key elements
The re-exports.

## Interactions
- The graph views over the catalog live in `app.ontology.graph` and `app.rag.unified_graph`.
